definitions.explanation: A meal packed in a box, typically eaten for lunch.

examples.japanese: お{弁当|べんとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
お{弁当|べんとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ってきた→持ってくる：10666_mottekuru⟧。

examples.english: I bought a boxed lunch at the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧お{弁当|べんとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: My mother makes a boxed lunch for me every morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遠足|えんそく}→遠足：04107_ensoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦とき→とき：02918_toki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧お{弁当|べんとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っていく→持っていく：27431_motteiku⟧。
examples.english: I always bring a boxed lunch on field trips.

notes:
お{弁当|べんとう} is a Japanese boxed lunch, a key part of Japanese food culture.

FORMS:
The お prefix is optional and polite. ⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧ is the plain form.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- お{弁当|べんとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make a bento
- お{弁当|べんとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っていく→持っていく：27431_motteiku⟧: to bring a bento
- お{弁当|べんとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy a bento

TYPES:
- ⟦{駅弁|えきべん}→駅弁：09702_ekiben⟧: train station bento (regional specialties)
- ⟦{幕|まく}の{内|うち}{弁当|べんとう}→幕の内弁当：16520_makunouchibentou⟧: traditional multi-item bento
- ⟦キャラ→キャラ：08916_kyara⟧⟦{弁|べん}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧: character-themed bento (cute designs)
- ⟦{日替|ひが}わり→日替わり：09745_higawari⟧⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧: daily special bento

CULTURAL NOTE:
Making お{弁当|べんとう} for family members, especially children, is a common practice in Japan.
